title: Rafael and the Radiators
author: Isandro Coldharbour
blurb: Wren Nystrom, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
